record.paper_title:
AIM Workshop “Pólya-Schur-Lax Problems: Hyperbolicity and Stability
Preservers” — A List of Open Problems
record.original_question:
Characterize the meromorphic functions F(x)=φ(x)/ψ(x), with φ and ψ
entire, such that whenever a real polynomial Σ a_k
x^k has only real zeros, the transformed polynomial Σ F(k) a_k x^k
also has only real zeros.

evidence.quote: Problem 24 ([24]). Characterize the meromorphic functions P F (x) = ϕ(x)/ψ(x), n where ϕ and ψ are entire functions such P that the polynomial k=0 F (k)ak xk has n only real zeros whenever the polynomial k=0 ak xk has only real zeros.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{P}_{\mathbb{R}}$ denote the set of polynomials in $\mathbb{R}[x]$ whose zeros are all real. Let $\varphi$ and $\psi$ be entire functions, and set $F(x) = \varphi(x)/\psi(x)$, viewed as a meromorphic function on $\mathbb{C}$. Say that $F$ is admissible if, for every integer $n \geq 0$ and every polynomial $\sum_{k=0}^{n} a_k x^k \in \mathcal{P}_{\mathbb{R}}$ such that $\psi(k) \neq 0$ for $k = 0, 1, \ldots, n$, the transformed polynomial
$$\sum_{k=0}^{n} F(k)\, a_k\, x^k$$
also belongs to $\mathcal{P}_{\mathbb{R}}$.

Give a complete characterization of all admissible meromorphic functions $F = \varphi/\psi$ of this form.
artifact.status_search_result: Classical Pólya–Schur theory characterizes entire-function multiplier sequences preserving real-rootedness, and extensions to differential operators and stability preservers have been developed (e.g., Borcea–Brändén). However, the meromorphic version asking for a full characterization of ratios $\varphi/\psi$ of entire functions acting as multiplier sequences on real-rooted polynomials does not appear to have a published complete classification, and is listed as an open workshop problem. No definitive resolution was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: Pólya–Schur master theorems for circular domains
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of linear operators preserving stability/real-rootedness via symbol functions in Laguerre–Pólya class.
status_evidence.claim: Classical and extended Pólya–Schur theorems characterize entire-function preservers; the meromorphic extension is a separate open question.

status_evidence.title: Real zero polynomials and Pólya–Schur type theorems
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses operators preserving real-rootedness and links to Laguerre–Pólya class.
status_evidence.claim: Available characterizations focus on entire symbols, not general meromorphic ratios.
